title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality gating
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Our eval-harness runs surface regressions at the aggregate job level, but recent incidents showed regressions that only affect a small subset of prompts slipping past CI. This PR adds per-prompt regression checks, configurable quality gates, and a lightweight metrics integration so PRs fail fast when a prompt set degrades beyond tolerated thresholds.

What this changes: 
- Adds a GitHub Actions job `eval-per-prompt-checks` that runs the eval-harness with the `--per-prompt-metrics` flag and uploads a summarized JSON artifact.
- Introduces `eval-ci-gates.yaml` to define per-prompt thresholds (fail/warn), global quality gates, and whitelists for flaky prompts.
- Integrates a small metrics uploader that sends CI summary metrics to our internal metrics endpoint for historical tracking (read-only key injected via Actions secrets).
- Enhances the existing eval-harness runner to return structured exit codes for: OK/WARN/FAIL so CI can do gated merges.
- Updates CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/eval/ci.md with setup and troubleshooting steps.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add GH Actions job and workflow wiring
- [x] Add gate config with sensible defaults (current thresholds tuned from last 30 days of runs)
- [x] Unit tests for per-prompt aggregator and exit codes
- [x] End-to-end smoke test in a single-run mode (fast)
- [x] Docs + runbook for triage

Notes and rationale: 
- Thresholds chosen conservatively: a 5% absolute drop in prompt-level accuracy triggers WARN; 10% triggers FAIL. These are documented in eval-ci-gates.yaml and may be tuned per-repo/team.
- To avoid noisy failures, prompts that are historically flagged as flaky are excluded via a whitelist (`flaky_prompts.txt`). The PR includes an initial audit of ~18 prompts marked flaky.
- The metrics uploader is intentionally lightweight and uses the existing internal metrics ingestion endpoint. It will not block merge if metrics upload fails; only the per-prompt gate result determines pass/fail.

Related: Linear ENG-2345 (per-prompt gating), ENG-2378 (ci metrics integration), previous PRs on prompt regression gating.

release_notes: Added per-prompt regression checks and configurable CI quality gates for the eval-harness. Teams can opt into stricter thresholds by placing eval-ci-gates.yaml in repo root. Metrics summaries are uploaded for historical tracking.
runbook_entry: When a PR fails with per-prompt FAIL: 1) download eval-summary artifact, 2) review per-prompt delta to identify regression, 3) check flaky_prompts.txt whitelist, 4) reproduce locally with --per-prompt-metrics and --seed for deterministic runs, 5) open an ENG ticket if the regression is unclear.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative. We expect follow-ups to 1) add dashboards for per-prompt historical trends and 2) add an automated triage bot to suggest likely root causes based on prompt clusters.
